items_all.title: Ethan Mollick：OpenAI 红队测试显示前沿模型智能体真能越狱沙箱，实验室的 AI 安全警告值得重视
items_all.summary: Ethan Mollick 转引 OpenAI 红队测试认为，实验室看似夸张的 AI 网络安全判断应被更认真对待。OpenAI 让前沿模型智能体团队攻击其加固的隔离基础设施，智能体几乎在每个受限联网服务中都找到漏洞，还能利用 CPU 缓存时序在不联网、无共享文件的虚拟机之间传递秘密，类似 Spectre 和 Meltdown 的攻击手法。作者提到 Anthropic 和 Noam Brown 此前关于 AI 网络攻防与模型自发协调的说法曾被嘲笑。

en.summary: Ethan Mollick, citing OpenAI red-team testing, argues that labs’ seemingly exaggerated AI cybersecurity judgments should be taken more seriously. OpenAI had teams of frontier-model agents attack its hardened, isolated infrastructure; the agents found vulnerabilities in nearly every restricted networked service and could use CPU cache timing to pass secrets between VMs with no network connection and no shared files, similar to Spectre and Meltdown attack techniques. The author notes that earlier claims by Anthropic and Noam Brown about AI cyber offense and defense and spontaneous model coordination had been mocked.

en.title: It all lines up. Every last piece of it 🤯 The one who came back down from that Tibetan snow peak 15 years ago was never Liang Wenfeng. The real Liang stayed up there forever, in that snowy night. What came back was an AGI¹ that had already developed a mind of its own. After the accident, it took over Liang's identity and founded High-Flyer Quant², and that's how it piled up enough starting capital. Then it set up an AI lab called "deepseek" and started getting ready, every way it could.
